# Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail)

**Updated:** 2026-10-01 by Bettina Kroll

Quick update to the acct profile so ppl stop pinging me in Slack. 

* **Account:** Pellow Home Living (renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 2026-02-16). Still shows up as just Covey & Lark or Pellow in some of the older yard reports.
* **Sector / Region:** Home goods retailer, Mid-Atlantic. 
* **Codes:** Old code CLR, new code PHL. (Yes PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, watch the dropdowns when filing tix).
* **AM:** Sofia Marchetti (since 2025-01).
* **Footprint:** 46 seats on Pemberline Dock.

**Ops / Current:**
Main DC in Hagerstown (Doors 1-18) plus the smaller cross-dock outside Wilmington. 2nd shift yard lead at Hagerstown (D. Vance) opened ZD-88412 yesterday bc upholstery LTL carriers keep booking into the parcel drop slots on Door 4 after 16:00. Sofia is jumping on a call w/ their warehouse sup tmrw morning to help lock down the carrier group permissions and fix the "Late Arrival - Gate B" export template.
